title: Art. 9.1.7 — Annex 14 - Aerodromes, Volume I - Aerodrome Design and Operations, Chapter 9 - Aerodrome Operational Services, Equipment and Installations, 9.1 Aerodrome emergency planning, 9.1.7
content: Recommendation. A fixed emergency operations centre and a mobile command post should be available for use during an emergency.
text: Recommendation. A fixed emergency operations centre and a mobile command post should be available for use during an emergency.
